hook: *5* private travel buses burn in a Dundigal parking yard
hook_b: *5* private travel buses burn in a Dundigal parking yard
tldr: A fire broke out on Saturday night in parked private travel buses at a yard near Bodrai, Bowrampet, in Dundigal. Three buses were gutted and two damaged.

beats.what: Three buses were completely gutted and two more caught fire and were damaged.
beats.why: The cause of the fire is not yet known; locals spotted it and alerted the fire department.
beats.care: Private travel buses carry many of the city's long-distance riders; the cause and loss are still being assessed.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Fire personnel rushed to the yard near Bodrai after locals raised the alarm.

cards.q: Do you check a private bus operator's safety record before booking?

viz.verdict: Bus operators lose vehicles; cause and loss not yet known
